zip.heading: CPAP Data (.zip or .cpapcard)
zip.hint: Upload a zip of your SD card: ResMed (its DATALOG folders), Sefam S.Box, Löwenstein Prisma or BMC / React Health Luna. The card is recognised by its files, and every night not yet stored is added and parsed automatically. A .cpapcard file from CpapDash Desktop (Export for HMS CPAP) also teaches a Sleep Bridge streaming here the card's layout.
zip.idle: Drag a .zip or .cpapcard here or click to choose
zip.layoutKept: Card layout kept: {{count}} Sleep Bridge(s) will use it.
zip.layoutKeptNoBridge: Card layout kept. The next Sleep Bridge that connects here will use it.
zip.layoutOff: Card layout kept for the Sleep Bridge, which is off in Settings.
zip.layoutRefused: Card layout not kept: {{error}} Your nights still import.

oxi.heading: O2Ring Oximetry Data (.csv or .vld)
oxi.hintPre: Upload a Wellue / Viatom "O2 Ring" CSV export (Share
oxi.hintPost: CSV in the Viatom app). SpO₂ and pulse are added as an oximetry session. A .vld file from the ring itself works too.
